items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: This was on account of John Hammond, I suppose.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Benny Goodman, you know, the Swing era had begun. And the William Penn Hotel, Count Basie was the first Black band to go into the William Penn Hotel. This was on account of John Hammond, I suppose.

But around Pittsburgh proper there were quite a few local bands that played at dances and some of the big affairs there. Around Pittsburgh there there was definitely a time between when you had a Black local and a white local. There was the Musicians Club in Pittsburgh, up on Wylie Avenue, which was headquarters, I suppose, for the local at that time.
